story.title: Story 2: Event Capture and Turn Derivation

result.reviewScopeSummary: Verified Story 2 AC-2.1 through AC-2.8 and TC-2.1 through TC-2.9 against the current capture implementation, capture tests, LHC intake behavior, health surfacing, and configured gates. Also audited production capture paths for fake adapters/shims/placeholders.

newFindings.title: No-id same-content events collide and are skipped as duplicates
newFindings.evidence: Tech design line 329 requires fallback idempotency keys to be identical for re-delivery of the same logical event and distinct across different events, using a role/timestamp/content-hash fallback. The implemented fallback in packages/pi-lhc/src/capture/idempotency.ts:37-57 omits timestamp/source order and uses only blockIndex, role, kind, and content. Production hook routing in packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts:348-354 calls mapMessage with only piSessionId, and local MessageEndEvent in packages/pi-lhc/src/pi/types.ts:36-38 carries only message, so messages without embedded entryId use the content-only fallback. Runtime changes in packages/pi-lhc/src/capture/runtime-changes.ts:38-48 also use the same content-only fallback. LHC skips duplicate idempotency keys in packages/lhc/src/domains/intake-stream/internal/pipeline.ts:210-216. A focused production-path node run through createConnector recorded two identical user prompts separated by agent_end as only ["user_prompt","turn_end"] with eventCount 2, proving the second finalized message and its turn_end were skipped instead of recorded.

verified: AC-2.1 / TC-2.1: user, assistant, and toolResult sequence records in source order; assistant fan-out thinking -> text -> tool_call is covered by packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/converter.test.ts.

AC-2.2 / TC-2.2 / TC-2.3: PI per-step turn_end is ignored, one LHC turn_end is emitted at agent_end, and repeated turnIndex 0 runs order by source order in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/turn-derivation.test.ts.
AC-2.3 / TC-2.4: parallel tool results arriving b then a retain toolCallId correlation in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/parallel-and-errors.test.ts.
AC-2.4 / TC-2.5: isError tool result records tool_result with error flag and content in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/parallel-and-errors.test.ts.
AC-2.5 / TC-2.6: graceful interrupt records partial assistant content, carries aborted disposition via runtime_note, and closes at agent_end in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/abort.test.ts.

AC-2.7 / TC-2.8: writable malformed input records a durable capture gap surfaced by inspect.health; unavailable store records extension health without throwing in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/converter.test.ts.

AC-2.8 / TC-2.9 partial: model_select and thinking_level_select each produce ordered runtime_note events with new and previous values for the covered single-change scenario in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/converter.test.ts.
unverified: AC-2.1 / AC-2.6: every finalized no-id PI message is not proven because repeated same-content messages collide on the content-only fallback and the later event is skipped.
AC-2.6 / TC-2.7: idempotency distinctness for different no-id events is unmet; current tests prove same-key replay skips, but not that distinct same-content events get distinct keys.
AC-2.8 / TC-2.9: repeated identical runtime changes are not proven because runtime_note keys are content-only and will collide.

gatesRun.command: focused node production-path proof: createConnector records two identical user prompts separated by agent_end

productionPathFindings: Production capture path still uses content-only fallback idempotency keys for no-id messages and runtime changes, so distinct same-content events can be skipped by LHC duplicate-key handling.
additionalObservations: No material fake adapter, mock path, shim, or placeholder was found in the Story 2 capture production path. Out-of-scope NotImplemented stubs remain in later-story modules, and the default observe-only provider fails closed rather than fabricating derived content.
